description: This file contains the authentication state management and providers for a Flutter app using Riverpod. It defines an immutable AuthState class, providers for the AuthRepository and AuthController, and functions for login, registration, and logout.

classes.name: AuthState
classes.description: Immutable class representing the authentication state, including token, user info, loading status, and error message.

methods.name: AuthState.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current AuthState with optional overrides.

methods.name: AuthState.initial
methods.description: Factory constructor for the initial authentication state.

methods.name: AuthController._init
methods.description: Initializes the controller by loading stored token if available.

methods.name: AuthController.login
methods.description: Handles user login by calling repository, updates state accordingly, and returns success status.

methods.name: AuthController.register
methods.description: Handles user registration, updates state, and returns success status.

methods.name: AuthController.logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing stored token and resetting state.

methods.name: AuthController._friendlyError
methods.description: Converts an exception into a user-friendly error message.
